description: Count your Router payment requests: `total` is how many there were in the period (uncapped, unlike list_payments) and `series` is that count per day (`date`, `value`), oldest first. `chargedNotDelivered` is the count of failed payments in the period whose merchant charge reconciliation observed on-chain (a failed payment not yet reconciled is not counted); this is the confirmed failed-and-charged count only. `countsByDeliveryStatus` exposes all six ledger delivery states, including `charged_unconfirmed`, `not_delivered` and `pending`, with zero counts included. The latter two have unknown charge outcomes: do not count them as confirmed charges. Flag both charged buckets and explain unresolved outcomes to the user. These buckets include calls paid with your Nevermined credits, so check `fundingSource` and `creditsStatus` in `list_payments` before telling the user they were charged. This reports numbers of payments, not money: for what has been spent or what is left, and how much of it was charged without delivery, use get_budget, and for amounts per payment use list_payments. Reading costs nothing. Requires your Nevermined API key on the Authorization header.

from.description: ISO-8601 lower bound on `createdAt`, inclusive. An unparseable value is an error.

to.description: ISO-8601 upper bound on `createdAt`, inclusive. An unparseable value is an error.
